statement: theorem quartic_ordinate_sign_bridge {K : Type} [CommRing K] (t y a b c B s alpha v x oldY newY : K) (half_a : 2*B=a) (half_b : 2*s=b-B^2) (alpha_law : alpha=c-2*B*s) (old_x : v=2*t^2+a*t-2*y) (new_x : x=2*(-y+t^2+B*t+s)) (old_y : oldY=2*t*(v+2*s)+c+B*v) (new_y : newY=2*x*t+B*x+alpha) : x=v+2*s ∧ newY=oldY ∧ 3*x+B^2-4*s=3*v+b
